summary: A compact glance stat card: a labelled headline metric with an optional hint, accent, and icon.
purpose: Use to surface a single at-a-glance number or short value on a dashboard. Compose several in a Grid to summarize a dataset. Built on the glass Surface so it matches the rest of the system.

anatomy.description: A raised glass Surface with a colored top rule that reflects the accent.
A small overline naming the metric.
Optional leading icon, tinted with the accent color.
The headline value, rendered large as a paragraph, not a heading.
Optional supporting line under the value for context.

props.name: label
props.description: Small uppercase label naming the metric.

props.name: value
props.description: The headline value: a number, a word, or a short phrase.

props.name: hint
props.description: Optional supporting line under the value for context.

props.name: accent
props.description: Colors the value and top rule using status tokens to signal severity of the metric.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading icon, tinted with the accent color.

variants.name: neutral
variants.description: No status color; value and rule use the default text and highlight colors.
variants.whenToUse: A plain metric that carries no severity signal.

variants.name: urgent
variants.description: Value and top rule take the urgent status color.
variants.whenToUse: A metric that flags a problem the user should notice.

variants.name: analysis
variants.description: Value and top rule take the analysis status color.
variants.whenToUse: A neutral analytical figure such as an average.

variants.name: success
variants.description: Value and top rule take the success status color.
variants.whenToUse: A metric that signals progress or a good state.

whenToUse: Summarizing a dataset as a row of glance metrics at the top of a dashboard.
Showing a single headline number with a label and short context.

whenNotToUse.scenario: Presenting a full record with title, body, and actions
Showing a trend or distribution over time
whenNotToUse.useInstead: a chart, not a single tile

do: Keep the value to a number, a word, or a very short phrase.
Use accent to signal severity, not decoration.
Group several tiles in a Grid so they read as one summary.
dont: Pack a sentence into the value; move context to the hint.
Rely on accent color alone to carry meaning; the label and value must still say it.

content.voice: Labels are short and uppercase. Values are terse. Hints add one line of plain context.
rules: Label names the metric in a few words.
Value is a glanceable figure or phrase.
Hint is one short supporting line.

tokensUsed.usage: Value and top rule for the urgent accent.
Value and top rule for the analysis accent.
Value and top rule for the success accent.

keyboard: No interaction of its own; a tile is a static readout.
aria: The value renders as a paragraph, not a heading, so a row of tiles does not pollute the heading outline.
accessibility.contrast: Accented values clear 3:1 as large text; label and hint clear 4.5:1 against the surface.
accessibility.focus: No focus target of its own.

examples.title: Urgent glance metric
examples.code: <Tile label="Messiest pattern" value="Avoidance" hint="3 of 6 cases" accent="urgent" />

related.whenToChoose: Use ProblemCard for a full case with detail and actions; Tile is a one-number summary.
Tile is built on Surface; use Surface directly when you need a bare container.
